game.name: Moto X3M
game.rules:
Please provide video evidence of your run.

Timing starts on your first input and ends when you reach the goal of the final level.

Only select PC as your platform if you are playing on the emulator.

Full game runs must complete all of the levels in order.

Farming runs results in a ban, run farmers are not welcome here, we are allowed to reject any runs that are suspected of farming.

IL runs must have individual videos or screenshots, no bulk videos with more than one level time

Top 3 IL Runs require video of the entire run

Slowruns are banned

newsList.title: New Recording Rule
newsList.body:
As of July 23rd, 2024, All top 3 runs (including level runs) must show the ENTIRE run

This applies to all games in the series

Runs without video submitted before this date will stay on the leaderboard

categories.name: Mobile
categories.rules:
Moto X3M app only. Free version only, paid is not allowed. This only goes up to 50 levels.

Video evidence is required for top 3 runs, photo evidence is fine for ranks lower than that

Individual levels are timed by In-Game Time.

Timed in Real-Time, Please display a timer on your screen during the speedrun.

Milliseconds are required for all top 5 runs

games.name: Moto X3M
games.rules:
Please provide video evidence of your run.

Timing starts on your first input and ends when you reach the goal of the final level.

Only select PC as your platform if you are playing on the emulator.

Full game runs must complete all of the levels in order.

Farming runs results in a ban, run farmers are not welcome here, we are allowed to reject any runs that are suspected of farming.

IL runs must have individual videos or screenshots, no bulk videos with more than one level time

Top 3 IL Runs require video of the entire run

Slowruns are banned
